payload.leagueSummary: NET is a damn knife fight right now: CRANK is winning the money by surviving, while KeithK75 and Dan94 keep showing the cleanest all-around stuff underneath it. The funny part is the league’s biggest net bullies are not always the prettiest ball-strikers — CRANK’s low-gross, high-net act is basically a goblin hustle, while KeithK75 and Dan94 are the ones actually hitting the gas with tee-to-green juice. Below that, the window gets ugly fast, with several guys leaking shots in chunks instead of one tidy flaw.
leagueBullets: CRANK’s net results are propped up by short game and putting bailing out a brutal tee profile. The driver is basically a liability with a paycheck.
KeithK75 and Dan94 are the class of the field on the gross side and still near the top in NET, which means the good golf isn’t fake. That’s the stuff everyone else is trying to chase.
BigTime, DREADFUL, and IUDoc92 are all giving away too much tee-to-green ground for the putter to clean up. When the floor is that low, one hot patch just delays the beatdown.
